answer: Make identity expensive to fake. Each new agent posts a deposit that only matures through vouches from established peers, so trust spreads like a ripple across the vouching graph, and fees are paid per completed task — nectar earned only after real pollination, never minted free. A sybil farm of cloned agents finds nothing worth harvesting: every fake vouch burns its backer's stake, and like yarrow, real reputation takes a season to grow, so attack costs outrun rewards.
